translations.african-market-page.hero.lede: Africa has the youngest population on earth and the highest rate of people starting a business. What it does not have is tooling priced for it. That is the whole gap IDEM works in.
translations.african-market-page.figures.title: The market, in six numbers
translations.african-market-page.figures.sources: Sources: GSMA Mobile Economy Sub-Saharan Africa, ITU, Partech Africa Tech Venture Capital Report, IFC.
translations.african-market-page.why.title: Why here, why now
translations.african-market-page.why.body: None of this is a forecast. Mobile money, the median age and the number of registered small businesses are all measured today.
translations.african-market-page.difference.title: What an imported platform gets wrong
translations.african-market-page.difference.lede: The problem is rarely the model. It is the price, the currency, the payment rail and the assumption that your customers read English.
translations.african-market-page.rollout.title: Region by region
translations.african-market-page.rollout.payments: A region counts as open when you can pay from it. Mobile Money is live in thirteen countries; the rest follow their operators.
translations.african-market-page.cta.title: Your turn
translations.african-market-page.cta.body: Describe your business in a few sentences and see the brand, the plan and the site it produces. Nothing to pay to find out.
translations.african-market-page.stat.population.desc: Median age nineteen — the youngest population of any continent, heading for 2.5 billion by 2050.
translations.african-market-page.stat.internet.label: Internet users
translations.african-market-page.stat.internet.descri: Growing about ten percent a year, and overwhelmingly on a phone rather than a desktop.
translations.african-market-page.stat.smes.label: Small businesses
translations.african-market-page.stat.smes.descriptio: They account for roughly eighty percent of employment on the continent.
translations.african-market-page.stat.mobileMoney.des: Africa carries more mobile money traffic than the rest of the world put together.
translations.african-market-page.stat.entrepreneurshi: The highest rate of new business creation measured anywhere.
translations.african-market-page.stat.startups.label: Tech companies
translations.african-market-page.stat.startups.descri: Active across the continent, three times the count of 2020.
translations.african-market-page.reason.mobile.title: The phone is the computer
translations.african-market-page.reason.mobile.descri: Products designed desktop-first lose most of the market on the first screen. Everything in IDEM is built to be used from a phone.
translations.african-market-page.reason.mobile.eviden: More than eight in ten connections are mobile.
translations.african-market-page.reason.payment.title: Payment is the real barrier
translations.african-market-page.reason.payment.descr: A card-only checkout stops most would-be customers before the first screen. Topping up a wallet by Mobile Money does not.
translations.african-market-page.reason.payment.evide: Mobile Money live in thirteen countries, billed in CFA francs.
translations.african-market-page.reason.young.title: A generation starting out
translations.african-market-page.reason.young.descrip: Sixty percent of the continent is under twenty-five, and the people entering the workforce are the ones creating the businesses.
translations.african-market-page.reason.young.evidenc: Around 200 million young people join the workforce by 2035.
translations.african-market-page.reason.sovereignty.d: When the tool, the hosting and the invoice all sit abroad, every price rise and every policy change lands on the entrepreneur.
translations.african-market-page.reason.sovereignty.e: Apache 2.0, self-hostable, data exportable at any time.
translations.african-market-page.advantage.price.desc: Every country has its own grid, built from local purchasing power rather than converted from a single currency.
translations.african-market-page.advantage.payment.de: MTN and Orange Mobile Money top up the wallet, and the wallet pays for what you generate.
translations.african-market-page.advantage.language.d: French, English and Portuguese today. The deliverables follow the language of your request, not the language of the site.
translations.african-market-page.advantage.accounting: Financial statements follow the SYSCOHADA chart of accounts, so a loan officer in Abidjan or Douala can read them.
translations.african-market-page.advantage.sovereignt: Deploy to managed hosting, to your own VPS, or to a machine in your office. The choice stays yours.
translations.african-market-page.advantage.open.title: A platform you can audit
translations.african-market-page.advantage.open.descr: African developers can read the code, fix it and run it. That is what sovereignty means in practice.
translations.african-market-page.region.central.name: Central Africa
translations.african-market-page.region.central.descr: Our home market. We know the registry, the tax calendar and the banks because we went through them ourselves.
translations.african-market-page.region.central.count: Cameroon, Gabon, Congo, Chad, Central African Republic
translations.african-market-page.region.west.name: West Africa
translations.african-market-page.region.west.descript: The largest tech market on the continent, and the one where Mobile Money coverage is deepest.
translations.african-market-page.region.west.countrie: Nigeria, Ghana, Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Benin, Togo, Mali, Burkina Faso
translations.african-market-page.region.east.name: East Africa
translations.african-market-page.region.east.descript: The platform works today; what remains is a payment agreement with each operator so you can top up locally.
translations.african-market-page.region.south.name: Southern Africa
translations.african-market-page.region.south.descrip: The most mature infrastructure on the continent, and the market where we compete head-on with international platforms.
translations.african-market-page.region.south.countri: South Africa, Botswana, Namibia, Zambia, Zimbabwe
